proposal.summary: Authenticated remote code execution in OpenEDX edx-platform Ironwood 2.5 when CodeJail is not enforced: an authenticated user can submit a Custom Python evaluated code problem containing arbitrary Python that runs on the server.
proposal.cwe_quote:

    os.system("thecommandyouwanttoexecute")

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify the vulnerability in a test instance, confirm whether CodeJail enforcement is configurable or missing by default, and if confirmed, apply code or configuration changes to enforce sandboxing (enable CodeJail or remove the Custom Python evaluated code feature) and release vendor advisory and patch.
